Square includes a modified copy of Yoga.Net 3.2.3, a C# port of Meta Yoga.
Upstream: https://github.com/chenrensong/Yoga.Net
Pinned revision: 1c7fd4a1ede445f5a3f9d5ae9239364b09d25154

Copyright (c) 2026 Chen Ren Song.
Copyright (c) Meta Platforms, Inc. and its affiliates.

The source is in src/Square/ThirdParty/Yoga. The upstream conformance tests
are retained in tests/Square.UI.Tests/Yoga. Square uses an internal namespace
and internal top-level types, and replaces StyleLength with an immutable
value type to avoid allocations when reading layout lengths.
Diagnostic event publication also skips payload construction and its publish
lock when there are no subscribers; subscribed event order and layout
statistics are preserved.

The upstream MIT license follows unchanged:
